title: A question to the owner stands on its own
label: dev

checks.name: there is a question to judge

reasons: Option 1 is marked as recommended, but the question never says what the harness will do if no answer comes.
Some terms are left unexplained: 'main', 'branch', 'commit', 'endpoint', 'old save route' and 'lands'.
The task and the reason for asking are clear: an open draft pull request overlaps with the «Substituir» (replace) button.
Each option says what will happen, for example who closes the pull request, what work gets reworked, or that the task waits in the queue.
At about 107 words, it is under the 120-word limit.
